en: You ancient, you free, you mountain-high North,
you quiet, you joyful fair one!
I greet you, loveliest land upon earth,
your sun, your sky, your green meadows,
your sun, your sky, your green meadows.
You are enthroned on memories of great days of old,
when, honoured, your name flew across the earth.
I know that you are and will be what you were.
Yes, I want to live, I want to die in the North!
Yes, I want to live, I want to die in the North!
notes: line 1.1: 'Nord' is 'the North', the land addressed throughout.
line 1.2: 'glädjerika' is 'rich in joy'; 'sköna' is 'beautiful one, fair one'.
line 2.1: 'fornstora dar' is 'days great in olden times'; 'tronar' is 'sits enthroned'.
line 2.4: 'Norden' is 'the North' (also the usual word for the Nordic countries).
